top_signals.title: How Valterra's Forging the Future of Platinum | Chief Financial Officer
top_signals.summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles Valterra Platinum CFO Sayurie Naidoo, who leads the world's largest company producing platinum group metals. One year after its demerger from Anglo American, the South African firm is looking ahead to develop new markets for PGMs as the adoption of battery electric vehicles threatens their primary area of demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Andrew Brandt on MLB Salary Cap Fight as World Series Begins
top_signals.summary: Andrew Brandt says the Brewers and Rays reaching the World Series—despite ranking 19th and 26th in payroll, respectively—shows how strong management, scouting and player development can compete with high spending. He calls the matchup evidence for the players’ union that success is possible without a salary cap, while cautioning that owners may dismiss it as an unsustainable exception: smaller-market teams have little margin for error and can lose players to wealthier clubs in free agency. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

alerts.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
alerts.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
